text:
Priya K: Heads up — inbound EUR wire hit our account this morning but remittance field only has 'INV-48' (too short). amount matches invoice 2026-03-15-048 though. customer says they paid via bank transfer. can we match?
Ethan L: can you paste the bank-provided reference and the sender name from the bank statement? often correspondent banks truncate or replace chars.
Priya K: Sender name on the bank notice is 'ACME EU LTD'. reference: 'INV-48/97' in their statement but in nostro file it shows just 'INV-48'. no other identifiers.
Ava M: ugh. If amount and date line up that's promising but we still need trace docs. ask customer for a copy of the payer's bank remittance (SWIFT MT103 or a bank PDF) — that usually has the full ordering customer info and the ordering/instruction reference.
Priya K: ok i'll ask them. any quick checks we can run here?
Ethan L: run a nostro lookup for that value + amount to see if any other hits. also check our ledger notes for any automated sweeps that reformat refs.
Ava M: command I use in payments ops: ```
# search nostro messages by amount + payer name
payments ops lookup --amount 12500.00 --currency EUR --from "ACME EU" --window 48h
```
Priya K: ran it, payments-bot returned one hit but the reference in the correspondent message is 'INV48' (no dash) and the ordering acct shows IBAN masked. attaching screencap. https://redwood.internal/screencaps/1778456789/remit.png
payments-bot: Ledger entry found: ID PAY-2026-0315-9001, amount 12,500.00 EUR, posted 2026-03-15 07:12Z, note: "corr-bank ref: INV48"
Ethan L: good. still need proof from customer to be safe for invoice allocation. can you request MT103 and ask them to confirm the invoice number + our customer ID?
Priya K: sending email now. cc'ing treasury. template below — feel free to tweak.
Ava M: paste the template here pls, I'll add the trace request wording.
Priya K: ``
Hi <Billing contact>,
We received an incoming EUR transfer that may correspond to invoice 2026-03-15-048. The bank reference we see is truncated to 'INV48'. Could you please send: 1) A copy or screenshot of the payer's bank confirmation (SWIFT MT103 or bank remittance PDF) showing the ordering customer and full instruction/reference; 2) The payment date and sending bank name; 3) Any internal payment reference used on your side.
With that we can complete reconciliation. If your bank prefers we issue a formal trace request (MT194/199), let us know and we'll escalate to our correspondent bank.
Thanks,
Priya (Redwood Billing)
```
Ethan L: add: "If you can forward the MT103, please include the block 20 and 21 fields" — those are super helpful for cross-bank traces.
Priya K: updated and sent.
Priya K: customer replied with attached MT103 PDF ~20m later. they included field 20: TRC20260315001 and ORG: "ACME EUROPE LTD".
Ava M: perfect. can treasury run a trace request with our correspondent using that transaction reference. i can submit it if you want.
Ethan L: once we have the MT103, accounting can post the payment and close the invoice. remember to attach the MT103 to the ledger entry for audit.
payments-bot: Attachments added to PAY-2026-0315-9001: mt103_acme_20260315.pdf
Priya K: accounting posted it as reconciled and added note: "match invoice 2026-03-15-048 using MT103 TRC20260315001" — closing on our side. thanks team :tada:
Ava M: nice. small follow-up: add a short KB about customers including our customer ID in the payment reference to reduce these hunts. i'll draft one.
Ethan L: agree — also add a line for treasury trace who/what to ask for (block 20/21 + ordering customer name).
Priya K: filing closure note and marking this thread resolved.
